Daily limit

A limit may only cover applications — the guard counts time by watching programs run, and a browser never reports back how long a site was open. Leave the times above empty for a limit that applies at any hour.

Governs

Turn protection off

The guard stays installed and keeps running, so it can turn protection back on by itself when the time is up.

Lock block

Once locked it cannot be shortened, changed, or removed until the deadline — not with the password, not by restarting.
